chapter_title: Concerning why Some shall delay to come forth from
spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation of 
¶2


The
 second
 state
 concerns
 this
: if the
 mind should
 decline
 from its elevation
 into
 a
 lower condition
 —
 a
 single
 interior
 faculty
, during
 a single passing
 state
 of spiritual
 life — there
 are
 other
 affections within
 the
 person
 that
 persist
 and
 do
 not fall
 with
 it.
 These
 aff
ections are held
 back
;
 they remain
 suspended
 in
 their progression
 until
 the faculty
 that
 declined
 is released
 from
 its bond
age to
 fals
ity.
 Yet
 even
 once
 it
 is freed, the
 remaining
 affections are
 slow
 to advance
 toward
 reunion
 with it
.

---

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [sec]ond [case is this:] if he shall fall [from his height into a lower place, being] one [member of the soul, in] one hour [of the life of light, there are] others who shall [not fall with him but abide] and they remain. They shall delay until they [perceive that] he is freed, and they delay to come toward [him and be joined with him once more.]
